description_en: A NEMA 17 stepper motor mount plate
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
plate_size = 50    # 安装板边长 (mm)
plate_t = 5        # 板厚 (mm)
center_hole = 22   # 中心孔径 (mm)
bolt_spacing = 31  # NEMA17 孔距 (mm)
bolt_d = 3         # 螺栓孔径 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(plate_size, plate_size, plate_t)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(center_hole)
)

# 4个安装孔
result = (
    result
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .rect(bolt_spacing, bolt_spacing, forConstruction=True)
    .vertices()
    .hole(bolt_d)
)

show_object(result)
